verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM's own docs say it reports on stage forecasts, win rate and sales activity. Its built-in Copilot returns reports or dashboards from plain-English requests, covering pipeline, activity and conversion inside the CRM without exporting. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the report/dashboard builder (customization, chart types, manual dashboard creation beyond Copilot), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Forecast by stage with weighted deal values, and report on win rate, sales activity and every deal that has gone quiet.
Ask what you would ask a sales analyst and get a report or a dashboard back.
Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests
